items.instructions: Choose the word that is closest in meaning to the word on the left.

explanation.en: To put off a meeting is to postpone it. Call off would mean to cancel it.
To turn down an offer or an invitation is to refuse it.
To come up with a plan or an idea is to think of it and suggest it.
To look into a problem is to investigate it and try to find out the facts.
To put up with something is to accept it without complaining, even though it is unpleasant.

items.instructions: Choose the word that matches each definition.

items.prompt: to fail to happen, usually because of a problem

explanation.en: A plan or a deal that falls through does not go ahead.

items.prompt: to succeed in doing something difficult or unlikely

explanation.en: To pull off something means to manage it against the odds, as in pull off a surprise win.

items.prompt: to make something seem less important or serious than it is

explanation.en: To play down a risk is to make it sound smaller than it really is.

items.prompt: to leave an important position, usually by choice

explanation.en: A chairperson or a leader who steps down gives up the post.
To run into someone is to meet them unexpectedly. It can also mean to hit something with a vehicle.
explanation.es: Run into también significa encontrarse con alguien por casualidad, no solo chocar.
